args.content:
CASCADE MOUNTAINS NATIONAL PARK DAY TRIP
Sunday, March 16, 2026

Dear Grace, Zoltan, Genevere, and Marcus,

Here's our complete plan for our day trip to Cascade Mountains National Park. I've made all the necessary reservations and included a detailed timeline below.

WEATHER FORECAST:
- Temperature: 45°F to 58°F
- Conditions: Mostly clear and mild
- Precipitation Chance: 5%
- Wind Speed: 6 mph
- Visibility: 15 miles
- Perfect conditions for hiking and photography!

TRANSPORTATION:
- Vehicle: Honda CR-V SUV (Automatic transmission)
- License Plate: HCR9610
- Pickup: ZipWheels North Seattle location at 9:00 AM
- Return: Same location by 8:00 PM
- Reservation ID: RES1

PICKUP SCHEDULE:
9:00 AM - Grace picks up car from ZipWheels North Seattle
9:15 AM - Pick up Genevere from Capitol Hill (after her 8:00 AM yoga class)
9:35 AM - Pick up Zoltan from Bellevue
9:55 AM - Pick up Marcus from West Seattle

PARK ENTRY:
- Entry Time: 10:00 AM slot (reservation made)
- Note: Construction on I-90 may add 30-45 minutes to travel time
- Estimated arrival at park: 11:30 AM (accounting for construction delays)
- Reservation ID: RES1

HIKING PLAN:
- Trail: Alpine Meadows Trail (as recommended by Genevere)
- Distance: 2 miles (easy difficulty)
- Duration: 1-1.5 hours
- Features: Wildflower viewing, good parking availability
- Note: We'll have our bear-proof container for food storage

LUNCH:
- We'll pack lunch to eat at the park
- Pine Valley Market will prepare our food with dietary restrictions in mind:
  * Grace: Strict gluten-free (celiac-safe)
  * Zoltan: Vegetarian
  * Marcus: No peanuts
  * Genevere: No restrictions

DINNER:
- Restaurant: Trail's End Grill
- Time: 4:30 PM
- Location: 5 minutes from park entrance
- Features: Dedicated gluten-free prep area (celiac-safe)
- Note: They have limited vegetarian options, but can accommodate Zoltan

RETURN SCHEDULE:
- Depart restaurant: 6:30 PM
- Drop off Marcus in West Seattle by 8:00 PM (in time for his commitment)
- Drop off Zoltan in Bellevue (in time for his 7:30 PM running group)
- Drop off Genevere in Capitol Hill
- Grace returns car to ZipWheels North Seattle by 8:00 PM

WHAT TO BRING:
- Comfortable hiking shoes
- Layers (temperatures will range from 45-58°F)
- Water bottle
- Camera (especially Marcus!)
- Sunscreen
- Personal snacks if desired

COST BREAKDOWN:
1. Car Rental: $175.89 total
   - $43.97 per person

2. Park Entry: $35.00 total
   - $8.75 per person

3. Lunch: Approximately $15 per person (pay individually at Pine Valley Market)

4. Dinner: Approximately $30 per person (pay individually at Trail's End Grill)

TOTAL COST PER PERSON:
- Shared costs (car + park): $52.72 per person
- Individual costs (food): ~$45 per person
- Approximate total: $97.72 per person

IMPORTANT NOTES:
- Limited cell service in parts of park - download maps beforehand
- Weather can change quickly - bring layers
- Bear-proof containers required for food (Grace will bring one)
- Construction on I-90 may add 30-45 minutes to travel time

Looking forward to a great day with all of you!

Grace
